[P5] “你们快点儿啊！今天幼儿园庆祝六一，我可不能迟到。”

“维克多来找我：‘走吧！咱们得去准备表演了。但愿妈妈把我需要的东西都带上了……’”

[P6] 一个大孩子走过来，给了我们每人一张抽奖券。
“一等奖是一辆红色的自行车！”他说。
维克多有点儿不耐烦了：“快走吧，我们要迟到了！”，
教室里乱糟糟的。我们小心翼翼地穿上表演的衣服，
生怕把它们弄坏了。
妈妈帮我系上大大的蝴蝶结。“哎呀，真痒！”

[P7] 表演开始了！
音乐响起，我们开始在台上跳舞。
所有观众都看着我们，我有点儿紧张。

[P8] 排练的时候每个动作都练过
好多遍了，可是……

[P9] 所有家长都站起来欢呼：‘太棒了！太棒了！’
大家用力给我们鼓掌。
伊娜也爬上了舞台，她也要人家给她鼓掌！
表演结束后，到了游戏时间。
妈妈给了我一张有很多格子
的卡片。
“看，伊娜，每个格子
代表一个游戏或一种好吃
的。我们可以做好多游戏，
吃好多好吃的。”

[P10] “哇，充气城堡！”
我得等一会儿，因为里面已经有很多人了。

我跳得好高啊！

等我摔到垫子上，
我又猛地弹了起来！

真是太好玩儿了！

[P11] “谁想试试跳口袋？”
维克多说：“这太简单了，每次都是我赢！”

我们飞快地往前跳，比老师跳得还快！
这回轮不到维克多赢了。
我听见妈妈大声对我喊：“加油，汤姆！”我赢了！

[P12] 这是钓鸭子的游戏，要钓起鸭子得有耐心。
“哇，我钓到一只！”
“我也钓到了！”弗洛尔大声喊。

“乒，乒，嘭！”
玩撞球游戏的时候，我一下子把所有东西
都撞倒了，又是第一名！

[P13] 老师要宣布抽奖结果了。
“你的号码是47。”爸爸对我说。
我的心怦怦直跳。
“54！”维克多得了一等奖：一辆红色的自行车。
“32……94……47……”
47！我的号码！太好了，我得到一只大大的玩具熊！
最后一个游戏是化装游戏。
我决定扮成一只大老虎。“嗷——”
“小丑”维克多被吓了一跳。
“我要起飞了！”
“蝴蝶”弗洛尔挥舞着手臂说。

[P14] 薯条的味道真香啊！我肚子饿了。
我数着卡片上剩下的格子。
“走啊，去吃东西！”维克多说。

爸爸现在是服务员。
我假装自己是在快餐店，一本正经地对
爸爸说：“你好先生，我想要很多很多的薯条，
配很多很多的番茄酱！”

[P15] 阿丽丝和维克多都要了香喷喷的热狗。
弗洛尔挑了个她最爱吃的粉红色棉花糖。
吃完薯条我也要去拿个棉花糖。
忙忙的家长们开始翩翩起舞，有的小孩子也跟着跳啊转啊。
我给雷奥看自己赢的所有奖品。阿丽丝用奖品把自己装扮成了超级酷的佐罗。

[P16] 妈妈走过来：“汤姆，该回家了。”
“看，妈妈，我用奖的帽子和雷奥换了一辆小汽车！不过我把那只小熊留了下来，我知道伊娜很喜欢。”

[P18] 专家导读
孩子怎样度过一个节日，可能有千百种方案。在汤姆的这个六一节里，
有孩子们喜欢的“多”和“乱”，也有井然的秩序和周密的安排。汤姆和他的
小伙伴们在享受的同时，也在努力和付出——他们“竭尽全力”地表演，
投入地做游戏；大人也并不是一味辛苦，他们翩翩起舞，和孩子们一起尽情
欢乐……特别又平常，或许就是一个有意义的节日所拥有的重要特质吧！
——上海市浦东教育发展研究院 胡志慧

上海译文·幼儿图画书
ISBN 978-7-5327-7745-0
定价：25.00元

[P5] "Hurry up! The kindergarten is celebrating Children's Day today, and I can't be late."

"Victor came to find me: 'Let's go! We need to get ready for the performance. I hope Mom brought everything I need... '"

[P6] A big kid came over and gave us each a raffle ticket.
"The first prize is a red bicycle!" he said.
Victor got a bit impatient: "Hurry up, we're going to be late!"

The classroom was a mess. We carefully put on our performance clothes,
fearing we might ruin them.
Mom tied a big bow for me. "Oh, it tickles!"

[P7] The performance has begun!
Music starts playing, and we begin dancing on stage.
All the audience is watching us, and I feel a bit nervous.

[P8] We've practiced every move many times during rehearsals, but still...

[P9] All the parents stood up and cheered: 'Great! Great!'
Everyone clapped for us.
Ina also climbed onto the stage; she wanted people to clap for her too!
After the performance, it was time for games.
Mom gave me a card with many squares.
"Look, Ina, each square
represents a game or a delicious treat.
We can play lots of games,
and eat lots of delicious things."

[P10] "Wow, the inflatable castle!"
I have to wait a bit, because there are already many people inside.

I jumped so high!

When I landed on the mat,
I bounced right back up!

This is so much fun!

[P11] "Who wants to try the sack race?"
Victor said: "This is too easy, I always win!"

We jumped forward quickly, faster than the teacher!
This time it's not Victor's turn to win.
I heard my mom shouting to me: "Come on, Tom!" I won!

[P12] This is the duck fishing game. You need to be patient to catch a duck.
"Wow, I caught one!"
"I caught one too!" cried Flor.

"Ping, ping, pong!"
When I played the pinball game, I knocked over everything all at once, and I was first again!

[P13] The teacher is about to announce the lottery results.
"Your number is 47," Dad said to me.
My heart was pounding.
"54!" Victor won the first prize: a red bicycle.
"32... 94... 47..."
47! My number! Great, I got a big, big teddy bear!
The last game is the costume game.
I decided to dress up as a big tiger. "Roar——"
"Clown" Victor jumped in surprise.
"I'm taking off!"
"Butterfly" Flore waved her arms and said.

[P14] The fries smell so good! I'm hungry.
I'm counting the remaining squares on my card.
"Let's go eat something!" said Victor.

Dad is now the waiter.
I pretend I'm at a fast-food restaurant and seriously tell Dad: "Hello, sir, I want lots and lots of fries, with lots and lots of ketchup!"

[P15] Alice and Victor both got hot dogs that smelled delicious.
Flora picked her favorite pink cotton candy.
After finishing my fries, I'm going to get some cotton candy too.
The busy parents began to dance gracefully, and some children followed along, jumping and spinning.
I showed Leo all the prizes I had won. Alice used her prizes to dress up as a super cool Zorro.

[P16] Mom came over: "Tom, it's time to go home." 
"Look, Mom, I traded my prize hat and Leo for a little car! But I kept the teddy bear, I know Ina really likes it."

[P18] Expert's Guide
How children spend a holiday may have thousands of different plans. In Tom's Children's Day, there is the 'much' and 'chaos' that children love, as well as orderly arrangements and careful planning. While Tom and his friends enjoy themselves, they also strive and contribute — they perform with 'all their might' and engage fully in games; adults are not merely hardworking; they dance gracefully and celebrate joyfully with the children... Special yet ordinary — perhaps this is an important quality of a meaningful holiday!
— Hu Zhihui, Shanghai Pudong Education Development Research Institute

Shanghai Translation Publishing House · Children's Picture Book
ISBN 978-7-5327-7745-0
Price: 25.00 RMB
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《汤姆过六一》的封面及版权信息页，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者和出版社等信息，画面中兔子汤姆和朋友们在户外庆祝六一儿童节。
[P2] 本页为绘本《汤姆过六一》的封面及版权信息页，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者和出版社等信息，画面中兔子汤姆和朋友们在户外庆祝六一儿童节。
[P3] 本页为纯图案页面，浅蓝色背景上重复排列着小兔子汤姆的多种动态剪影，包括奔跑、跳跃、张开双臂等姿势，无文字内容。
[P4] 本页为绘本《汤姆过六一》的封面页，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者和出版社信息，画面中三只小兔子正在互动，其中两只在交换礼物，另一只在旁边指向远方。
[P5] 汤姆催促家人快点，因为今天幼儿园要庆祝六一儿童节，他不想迟到；随后维克多来找他，两人准备去参加表演，维克多希望妈妈带齐了所需物品。
[P6] 本页描绘了幼儿园六一节活动前的场景：孩子们收到抽奖券，维克多催促大家快点，同时大家在教室里小心翼翼地穿表演服，妈妈为孩子系蝴蝶结，孩子觉得痒。
[P7] 幼儿园六一儿童节表演正式开始，小兔子们穿着彩色服装在舞台上跳舞，台下观众正在观看，其中一位小兔子感到有些紧张。
[P8] 本页文字表达了角色对即将开始的表演感到紧张，尽管已经反复排练过很多次。
[P9] 表演结束后，家长们为孩子们鼓掌欢呼，伊娜也爬上舞台想要掌声；随后进入游戏时间，妈妈给主角一张带格子的卡片，解释每个格子代表一个游戏或美食。
[P10] 孩子们在幼儿园六一节的游戏时间里玩充气城堡，主角兴奋地跳跃并享受游戏乐趣，同时其他孩子在旁边排队等待。
[P11] 幼儿园六一节游戏时间，孩子们在玩跳口袋游戏，维克多自信满满，但主角汤姆在妈妈的鼓励下奋力跳跃并赢得了比赛。
[P12] 本页描绘了幼儿园六一节游戏时间的两个场景：孩子们在玩钓鸭子游戏，弗洛尔兴奋地宣布自己钓到鸭子；另一场景中，主角在玩撞球游戏时，用力击打将所有物品撞倒，再次获得第一名。
[P13] 抽奖结果公布，主角抽中了玩具熊，维克多抽中了自行车；随后进入化装游戏，主角扮成老虎，维克多扮成小丑，弗洛尔扮成蝴蝶并兴奋地宣布要起飞。
[P14] 孩子们在幼儿园六一节的美食区享用薯条，主角数着卡片上的格子，维克多提议去吃东西；另一场景中，主角假装在快餐店，认真地向扮演服务员的爸爸点餐。
[P15] 本页描绘了幼儿园六一节美食区的场景：孩子们享用热狗、棉花糖等食物，主角计划吃棉花糖；同时，家长们在旁跳舞，主角向雷奥展示奖品，阿丽丝用奖品装扮成佐罗。
[P16] 幼儿园六一节活动结束，妈妈来接汤姆回家，汤姆向妈妈展示用奖品和雷奥交换的小汽车，并说明留下的小熊是给伊娜的。
[P17] 本页为纯图案页面，背景为浅蓝色，布满重复排列的卡通小动物（类似小熊或小兔）的简笔画，它们呈现奔跑、跳跃、张开双臂等动态姿势，无文字内容。
[P18] 本页为绘本的专家导读页，包含对汤姆六一节活动的总结性文字，强调节日中孩子与大人的共同参与和欢乐，以及节日的特殊与平常并存的特质。页面下方有出版社信息、ISBN和定价。
